verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management SaaS, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence covers its APIs, attachments, filings, audit trails, exports and workflows, but nothing describes a way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The developer docs are password-gated, so this cannot be checked further.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
